scope: Atomic retained-document binding updates and single-activation retry
negative_control: First editor changed state first=edited before second binding returned Expected scalar text; model differed from original despite Err
implementation: stage root state and commit only after all bindings succeed
preserve sequential and aliased writes inside the staged state
do not create a root state scope on an error
restore uncommitted last activation for retry; consume only after binding acceptance
share bounded annotation between render and recovery; check structural depth/count before recursively cloning children
regressions: public render-and-sync metadata failure leaves all scopes unchanged
cached scene metadata failure leaves all scopes unchanged
empty states vector remains empty on failure
repair metadata then retry successfully applies pending editor input
recovery and rendering reject depth >64 and node count >16384
legacy and Svet retain one activation through two failed attempts; repair applies it once; subsequent no-op does not toggle again
limitations: single pending activation slot; multiple new activations during failure are not qualified as an event queue
collection identity/reordering across failed renders remains open
nested Value payload depth and all malformed metadata classes are not qualified by structural tree bounds
staging clones the root state; large-model latency/peak-memory cost remains unmeasured
no new real-window/GPU or remote CI qualification in this change
